# PPL scalar function reference

Every PPL scalar function name. A name maps onto an IR registry function, is lowered onto IR operators, or is unsupported and fails with `UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION`. NULL behavior and errors are those of the IR function.

| Function | Category | Support | Semantics |
|---|---|---|---|
| `abs` | math | full | Absolute value. |
| `acos` | math | full | Trigonometric or angle-conversion function acos in radians; NULL outside its domain. |
| `add` |  | full | lowered to arithmetic operator + |
| `adddate` |  | full | lowered to date_add |
| `addtime` | datetime | full | t plus the time of day or duration delta. |
| `array` | collection | full | Array of the arguments. |
| `array_length` | collection | full | Number of elements of a; NULL for non-arrays. |
| `ascii` | string | full | Code point of the first character of s, 0 for the empty string. |
| `asin` | math | full | Trigonometric or angle-conversion function asin in radians; NULL outside its domain. |
| `atan` | math | full | Arc tangent of x, or with two arguments of y/x using the signs of both to pick the quadrant. |
| `atan2` | math | full | Arc tangent of y/x using the signs of both to pick the quadrant. |
| `avg` | math | full | Arithmetic mean of the arguments. |
| `cbrt` | math | full | Cube root. |
| `ceil` | math | full | Smallest integer not less than x. |
| `ceiling` | math | full | Smallest integer not less than x. |
| `cidrmatch` | ip | full | TRUE when the IPv4 or IPv6 address ip is inside the CIDR block cidr; NULL when either does not parse. |
| `coalesce` | condition | full | The first argument that is not NULL, or NULL. |
| `concat` | string | full | Concatenation of the arguments' string forms; NULL when any argument is NULL. |
| `concat_ws` | string | full | Concatenation of the non-NULL arguments separated by sep. |
| `conv` | math | full | x read as a number in from_base, written in to_base (2-36). |
| `convert_tz` | datetime | full | t read as wall-clock time in from_tz, rewritten as wall-clock time in to_tz; NULL for unknown zones. |
| `cos` | math | full | Trigonometric or angle-conversion function cos in radians; NULL outside its domain. |
| `cosh` | math | full | Trigonometric or angle-conversion function cosh in radians; NULL outside its domain. |
| `cot` | math | full | Trigonometric or angle-conversion function cot in radians; NULL outside its domain. |
| `crc32` | math | full | CRC-32 (IEEE) checksum of the UTF-8 bytes of s. |
| `curdate` | datetime | full | The start (00:00 UTC) of the reference time's day. |
| `current_date` | datetime | full | The start (00:00 UTC) of the reference time's day. |
| `current_time` | datetime | full | The reference time's time of day as a duration since midnight UTC. |
| `current_timestamp` | datetime | full | The query's reference time. |
| `curtime` | datetime | full | The reference time's time of day as a duration since midnight UTC. |
| `date` | datetime | full | The start (00:00 UTC) of t's day; t may be a timestamp or a date or timestamp string. |
| `date_add` |  | full | lowered to date_add |
| `date_format` | datetime | full | t formatted with MySQL-style % specifiers. |
| `date_sub` |  | full | lowered to date_add |
| `datediff` | datetime | full | Whole days from b's date to a's date. |
| `datetime` | datetime | full | t as a timestamp, converted to time zone to_tz when given. |
| `day` | datetime | full | Day of month (1-31) of t. |
| `day_of_month` | datetime | full | Day of month (1-31) of t. |
| `day_of_week` | datetime | full | Day of week of t, 1 = Sunday to 7 = Saturday. |
| `day_of_year` | datetime | full | Day of year (1-366) of t. |
| `dayname` | datetime | full | English name of t's weekday. |
| `dayofmonth` | datetime | full | Day of month (1-31) of t. |
| `dayofweek` | datetime | full | Day of week of t, 1 = Sunday to 7 = Saturday. |
| `dayofyear` | datetime | full | Day of year (1-366) of t. |

| `from_days` | datetime | full | The date n days after year 0. |

| `json_keys` | json | full | JSON array text of the top-level keys of the JSON object s; NULL for non-objects. |
| `json_object` | json | full | JSON object text from alternating keys and values. |
| `json_set` | json | full | s with the value at each path replaced or created. |

| `last_day` | datetime | full | The start of the last day of t's month. |
| `latest` |  | full | lowered to time comparison |
